shared_elements: low-relief carving with dense allover surface detail
stylized curvilinear/scroll motifs filling the field
frontal or profile head as a focal element
justification: A shows a naturalistic animal (a horned quadruped in profile with mane, eye and muzzle) whose body is covered in repetitive curl and scale patterning, whereas B shows a frontal standing human figure with an elaborate towering headdress and ornaments, set on a base amid rubble. The only real correspondence is the shared habit of dense, low-relief, scroll-filled surface decoration around a central head; the subjects, postures and compositional logic are otherwise unrelated.
